Parser API and data structures for slot delta entries and grouped transaction hashes.

# Purpose
This header defines the public interface for a slot delta parser used in restore utilities. It declares the opaque parser type `fd_slot_delta_parser_t`, the `fd_sstxncache_entry_t` record for slot, block hash, transaction hash, and result data, and the `fd_slot_entry_t` node used by the internal pool and map containers. It also includes the generated pool and map templates for slot storage, plus function pointer types for callbacks that process groups and entries. The file exposes parser lifecycle functions, buffer size and alignment queries, and [`fd_slot_delta_parser_consume`](<#fd_slot_delta_parser_consume>) with status codes and result data for incremental parsing.
